title: ptilostemon rhiphaeus
intro: Ptilostemon rhiphaeus, commonly known as Rock Rose, is a plant species in the family Cistaceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Rock Rose include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
